fact: The National Council for Human Rights submitted a memo on safeguards for a future access to information law to the Cabinet, the Ministry of State for Information and both houses, with no such law yet in force.
title: «الحق في الحصول على المعلومات».. تفاصيل مذكرة القومي لحقوق الإنسان إلى الحكومة والبرلمان
